| Path | Role | Binding? |
|------|------|------------|
| `go/`, `python/`, `wasm/` | — | Absent |
| `shim/` | Swift macOS menubar app; HTTP client to daemon API (`Package.swift`: "thin AppKit view layer over the mnemo daemon's HTTP API") | No — UI head, not a core wrapper |

| `examples/plugins/` | Out-of-process plugin example | No |
| Root `main.go` + `internal/` | Single Go binary daemon | Core product, not a publishable binding surface |

mnemo ships as one HTTP MCP daemon (`package main` at repo root). There is no separate Go/Python/WASM wrapper module exposing store/compress/compactor APIs to other languages.

### T162 / T163 and test coverage
Release features are daemon-internal only:

- **T162** (auto compression backfill): `internal/store/compress_auto.go`, `compress.go`, registry wiring — covered by Go tests in `internal/store/`.
- **T163** (compactor deferral quarantine): `internal/compact/`, `internal/store/compactions.go` — covered by `TestSelectCompactionCandidatesIgnoresDeferredQuarantine`, `TestWatcherDefersNonPayload`, etc.

No binding-layer test gap for this release; coverage lives in the core Go test suite.

### Release skill scope
Phase B item 11 targets language-specific wrappers (`go/`, `python/`, `wasm/`, similar). mnemo has none. `shim/` is outside discover.sh’s binding list and is not a language binding to core logic.
